**Merge-friendly workflow (ROADMAP-3 item 80.1):** changes add `changelog.d/<slug>.md` fragments that `release-notes assemble` moves under the unreleased heading (`--check` lists pending ones); generated files (`tests/cli_help_golden.json`, `docs/COMMANDS.md`, `docs/CHECKS.md`) carry `merge=bfregen` with the opt-in driver `tools/merge-regen.py` (take theirs, record) and `tools/regen-generated.py`; `tools/prepush-check.ps1` also runs the fast cross-cutting tests and the tests of touched modules; `merge-train PR...` merges PRs in order via `gh`, rebasing each next branch (CHANGELOG.md keeps both sides, generated files regenerate, other conflicts stop), testing and force-pushing with lease.
